title: Unit Event — Deeper and Deeper — Episode8 What I've Grasped

meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime agrees to participate in a workshop run by ArcLand. As Rui takes the directors' course, he is confronted with something he's never realized about himself before.

rows.Line: se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The hunter's words compel the monster to take a hard look at himself.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (At creature that does not belong.)

rows.Speaker: Hunter
rows.Line: “It's transformed into a human and is currently masquerading around as one of you. However, its true nature is fundamentally inhuman.”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “Right...”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line:
“I love to have fun.
That's why I do things humans view as dangerous, or even hurt people.”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line:
“That's what I've been doing until now.
I may look like a human now, but I haven't actually changed.”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “But that is just who I am.”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line:
“I was born this way.
How do you change that?”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “I didn't want to be born a monster.”

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: (For a scene like this, normally you'd have the actor rage and weep, or else visibly struggle to repress his emotions...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For this scene, I'd like you to refrain from showing strong emotion.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Refrain from it? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In this scene... The monster is feeling a deep sense of despair regarding his own existence.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
He can't run from who he is.
He can't change his fundamental nature, either.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No matter how much he kicks and screams, he'll never be like those around him.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He knows that better than anybody else.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (He's never had someone who can understand him. And that loneliness has been his only, constant companion.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (He thought he'd come to terms with it already... But he finds himself at a crossroads here.)

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “It was only ever a matter of time until I hurt Master or the people of this city...”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “Which means it might be time to leave. Tonight.”
“Hold it.”
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line:
“Hunter...
Out hunting monsters this late at night? You're certainly dedicated.”

rows.Speaker: Hunter
rows.Line:
“Yes, I am...
And now I've finally pinned you down.”

rows.Speaker: Hunter
rows.Line: “Humans don't go walking around on moonless nights without even a lantern to light the way, after all.”
se_event_deeper_2025_005

rows.Speaker: Hunter
rows.Line:
“I will end you here.
To avenge all the innocents you have harmed, monster.”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line:
“Hahaha! Is that so...!
I might actually be okay with that.”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “If my death will bring peace, then it's a small cost to pay.”
se_run_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Minstrel
rows.Line: “Please, wait!”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “M-Master?! Why are you here?”

rows.Speaker: Minstrel
rows.Line:
“Why wouldn't I be here?!
Anyone would be worried if their apprentice was acting really strange!”

rows.Speaker: Hunter
rows.Line: “Please, step aside.”

rows.Speaker: Hunter
rows.Line:
“That thing is not your apprentice.
Merely a monster wearing a human face.”

rows.Speaker: Minstrel
rows.Line: “He might be a monster, but he's also my valued apprentice.”

rows.Speaker: Minstrel
rows.Line: “And a budding minstrel with the ability to make people smile.”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line:
*Wince*
“I...”

rows.Speaker: Hunter
rows.Line: “What nonsense.”

rows.Speaker: Hunter
rows.Line: “Does this mean you're willing to take responsibility the next time this monster harms another person?”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “It's true. No ordinary human would be able to stop me.”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “When I find something fun, I can't stop myself. I prioritize my own desires over everything else.”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “So, when that happens...”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “You can shoot me dead, then and there.”

rows.Speaker: Hunter
rows.Line: “What...?”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line:
“I will always be a monster.
That will never change.”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “Still, even so...”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “If there are those who will accept me, even knowing that I'm a monster...”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “Then, I'd like to stay here.”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “Yes, you are right. I have caused harm to others.”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “I never cared about them. If we could never understand each other, it didn't matter what I did to them. But...”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “Now, seeing people smile as I sing makes my chest feel warm.”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “I've become motivated to do better next time and surprise them with how good I've gotten.”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “I... Care about these humans now.”

rows.Speaker: Hunter
rows.Line: “A monster like you has no business uttering such words.”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “I know you don't believe me. But I am telling the truth.”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line:
“I'll do anything to convince you.
If you need me to pay a price, then you can take one of my eyes, legs or anything else.”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “So, please... Won't you give me a chance?”

rows.Speaker: Minstrel
rows.Line: “P-Please, I also beg you!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The hunter has her own beliefs...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Changing her mind won't be easy. Which is why...)
se_event_deeper_2025_006

rows.Speaker: Hunter
rows.Line: “You aren't fooling me.”

rows.Speaker: Minstrel
rows.Line: “A gun...!”

rows.Speaker: Hunter
rows.Line:
“An eye or a leg, you said?
Neither of those will be enough to make up for your crimes.”

rows.Speaker: Hunter
rows.Line: “Begone.”

rows.Speaker: Hunter
rows.Line:
“You're not dodging?
Next, it won't be just your leg. I'll be aiming for your heart.”

rows.Speaker: Minstrel
rows.Line:
“P-Please, stop!
You'll kill him!”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “No, Master, it's okay.”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “I'll take as many shots as I need to convince her.”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line:
“Kill me if you feel you must.
You're right that things will be much more peaceful once I'm gone.”

rows.Speaker: Hunter
rows.Line: “Show me your leg. I'll treat the wound.”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “What...?”

rows.Speaker: Hunter
rows.Line: “There is no way for me to know if a monster like you can have a conscience. Or if you truly intend to change your ways.”

rows.Speaker: Hunter
rows.Line: “So, I will set up camp near this city.”

rows.Speaker: Hunter
rows.Line: “I shall stay until I see that you are able to keep your word.”

rows.Speaker: Minstrel
rows.Line: “That's the end of the monster's story.”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “The monster who struggled to change his ways continued to live amongst the humans, but what happened next, nobody knows.”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “This story probably doesn't end with a happily ever after.”

rows.Speaker: Minstrel
rows.Line: “But one thing is for certain...”

rows.Speaker: Monster
rows.Line: “He's no longer alone.”

rows.Speaker: Veteran Director
rows.Line: Hmm... This definitely wasn't what I was expecting.

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: Me neither. Honestly, I expected him to give us something straight down the mainstream.

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line: <“Conceptually, it's a fairytale that adults can also enjoy.”>

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line: <“The depiction of the lonely, selfish monster's growth, as well as the humanity of those who interact with him, felt so real.”>

rows.Speaker: Veteran Director
rows.Line:
I agree.
But having this shown at ArcLand...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... They seem to be having a lively discussion regarding what they just saw.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, but I can't hear what they're saying...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, they're waving us over!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I think that means they're finished.
I'll head over now.
se_walk_men_002_2

rows.Speaker: Veteran Director
rows.Line:
Ahem. Thank you for your patience.
We'll begin announcing our thoughts regarding your show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm ready.

rows.Speaker: Veteran Director
rows.Line: First, we all gave your detailed portrayal of the psychological aspects of this show very high marks.

rows.Speaker: Veteran Director
rows.Line: Despite the fairytale setting, you had the audience experience the protagonist's unfair reality and the resulting loneliness and internal conflict he felt.

rows.Speaker: Veteran Director
rows.Line: However, this was also where opinions split most sharply.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I understand.

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: Frankly, some sections were a little too raw to attach ArcLand's name to this.

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: You got together some nice ingredients, but didn't quite cook them properly.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line: <“Yes, it felt unbalanced in many ways.”>

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line:
<“But I liked it overall.
It was sincere, passionate, and very compelling.”>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Thank you very much.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “This workshop has taught me so many different things.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “This time around, I wasn't able to strike the proper balance with my audience's demands...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “But I promise to apply this experience to my next show.”

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line: <“Hehe. There's no need to rush.”>

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line: <“You've got a long lifetime of shows ahead of you, after all.”>

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line: <“Just as today's show was a wonderful expression of everything you've experienced up until now...”>

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line: <“Moving forward, I'm sure you'll be able to go deeper and deeper. I'll be looking forward to seeing what that results in, Rui.”>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Thank you. I'll do my best.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Based on his expression, I think he's happy with their assessment.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah.

So, this Kamishiro kid...
He got what I was trying to say?

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
He did.
But he mainly works on stage productions.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
The same as you.
Which means you'll probably cross paths someday.

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: Bravo, Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Sakaki
rows.Line: This is going to get very interesting.
